title: Volume 1 Interlude: Miscalculation? 【Patricia Kindred】
content: The dungeon practice that had consumed half a day was finally coming to an end, and it was after school when all the students finished their classes and began to spend their time as they pleased.
"Is it time already?"
In a certain room of the dormitory, which only allowed royalty or high-ranking nobles to reside, a red-haired male student, Jelasis Gran Ignite, was expelling something dark red from his mouth.
"Ugh... gack."
Blood, or perhaps something else. Or maybe both.
In the dimly lit room, it was hard to tell, but the pulsating mass in the bucket prepared beforehand looked like some kind of organ.
"Ugh, it’s always so disgusting to see."
"I'm sorry."
I threw a towel at Jelasis, who wiped his mouth with his sleeve.
The red-stained towel would never be white again, no matter how much it was washed, so it had to be burned and disposed of.
"So, were you able to retrieve the holy artifact?"
That was the reason I had come to his room.
Jelasis paused for a moment before answering my question.
"…Sorry, I couldn’t."
"You idiot! This is the worst!"
With my blood boiling, I kicked Jelasis squarely in the face as he knelt on the ground, struggling after vomiting.
He was truly useless, and I took advantage of his defenselessness to stomp on him repeatedly.
"I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry."
"Is that all you can say? You're truly pathetic, utterly hopeless."
Having grown tired of kicking him, I sat down again, crossing my legs as I asked.
"So, what happened?"
"I was interrupted."
"By whom? Where? How? I want all the details."
Retrieving that holy artifact was essential for progressing the current scenario and for me to remain the main character on this stage.
I had gone out of my way to send him to retrieve it, and he failed?
Failed, despite being possessed by a demon?
This was something close to my trump card that I had nurtured since before the story began. What on earth was going on?
"Tell me, who interrupted you?"
"Lagna Vel Brave."
"Tch, that mob noble."
I couldn’t help but click my tongue.
He had forced Alicia into breaking off her engagement as per the scenario.
I had planned to take extra precautions and turn that worthless bug into a villainess, but instead, she returned to the academy with an unknown man.
That man was Lagna Vel Brave.
A mob noble from the outskirts who would vanish on his own as the story progressed.

The Alicia I remembered was a wicked woman consumed by her desire for revenge, yet somehow, the current Alicia, who returned to the academy with him, seemed calm as if the demon had been exorcised from her.
"Ugh, I can’t use the Edward route anymore."
It was much better than falling into an unpredictable situation, but there was no longer a pressing need to follow the scenario.
But it was infuriating. What was that man’s deal?

I had intimidated the minor characters surrounding Alicia with the power of the Ignite family, turning them into villains, but minor characters were still minor characters and couldn’t become the story's true antagonists.
"Well, it’s not like there’s only one holy artifact, so maybe it’s fine."
Losing the shortest route was a setback, but I had other plans.
I needed to mislead this damn fate; I still had to remain the protagonist on this stage.
"For that, I need to remove my worries, right?"
Lagna Vel Brave.
The fact that he came to retrieve the holy artifact likely meant he knew the scenario.
After all, he was originally destined to not exist, just like me.
"Seriously, it’s infuriating, infuriating. Fate can go to hell."
"There's blood; I need to treat it..."
As I bit my nails, I realized I had unknowingly broken one and it was digging into my skin.
Am I so anxious that I didn’t even notice?
No, fate is pretending to go smoothly while it’s actually going crazy.
"Shut up, you idiot. First, you. Come on, take off your clothes."
I stood up and approached Jelasis, who was sitting on his knees in front of me.
He seemed to be desperately holding back, but he was reaching his limit.
I stripped him of all his dirty clothes to begin treatment.
"Tell me where you were hurt. You’re at your limit, right?"
"First, my neck... ugh."
Just as he said, I made a clean cut on his neck.
He gritted his teeth against the pain as I wrapped my hands around his neck and immediately cast recovery magic.
"Next?"
"My heart, and since I used self-detonation, my whole body... cough."
A hole opened in his chest, blood gushing out, and then burn-like scars spread all over his body.
Feeling disgusted by the sight, I still embraced Jelasis.
"Don’t worry; I’ll heal you completely."
When did I first learn that blood was warm?
Since that time, his blood has remained warm.
I could feel his heartbeat thumping strongly, clinging to life.
"You really took a beating. You did well, good job."
"Th-thank you... u..."
After healing all the recoil wounds from using the demon’s power, Jelasis finally regained his composure.
Ah, Jelasis.
You’re a crybaby and a coward, but you’re my cute, cute—little brother.
So, I can’t let you die yet.
"Patricia."
"For now, just call me sister."
"Sister... that guy was really strong."
As he hugged me back tightly, he said.
"I probably can’t win."
"Is that so? After all that effort?"
"But, but, it didn’t work at all..."
"But still, you’ve never shown your true strength, have you?"
"I haven’t, but... I still don’t know..."
From the recoil wounds, it seemed he had his head cleanly severed in one blow.
He’s the same kind of existence as me, yet he could do something so gruesome?
Well, if our circumstances are the same, that can’t be helped.
Having had his neck cut, heart gouged out, and forced to use self-detonation with intense pain throughout his body, my brother was trembling in fear.
I could feel his terror radiating from the body I held.
"Hey, uh—Jelasis?"
I grasped his face to meet his eyes, asking while looking into his distorted, hazy, yet incredibly beautiful gaze.
"What do you want? Tell your sister."
"I... want Alicia, ever since I saw her through the prison window long ago."
"Then, who ruined everything, even though I was trying to set it up for you to be with her?"
"…Lagna Vel Brave."
"Then, you know you have to kill him to take what you want, right? The thing you desire is currently in his possession."
"B-but..."
"Trust me. You’re special. And you haven’t lost yet, have you? Because you’re still alive like this."
He is a rare and special existence, just like me, who appears in this story.
A special little brother who has harbored a demon since birth and has been despised.
"Sister..."
Jelasis closed his eyes, looking greedy.
"If you can still keep trying, I’ll always be by your side."
Saying that, I kissed Jelasis.
I intertwined my tongue and sent magic power into him through our mouths, restoring his battered insides.
I needed to keep him from falling into madness.
I can’t let this child break or be destroyed.
"Thank you, sister."
With a dreamy expression, Jelasis said.
"I’ll do my best."
"Yeah, keep trying."
As I said this, a little light returned to his hazy eyes. That’s good.
"I’ll definitely win next time."
"Jelasis, actually, you’ve already won."
"How come?"
"You’ve held hands with a cute girl, been embraced, and even kissed. That’s different from those mob guys."
"Is that a win?"
"Of course. Those little monkeys at the academy live for that. Just try provoking them, and you’ll see."
If Jelasis provoked them, they would surely shed blood tears in frustration.
Hehe, it’s amusing.
Now then, Lagna Vel Brave.
I don’t know what your purpose is for stepping onto this stage in this scenario, but I will never stop. I can’t stop.
If you continue to stand in my way, I won’t show mercy.
To this damn fate, to this damn world, I will bring about its collapse──.
